A LITTLE KNOW-HOW GOES A LONG WAY

WHAT MAKES A
USEFUL SERVICE BRIEF?

KIT & RACKET CARE

The equipment you use

Note the model, age and the issue you want to discuss. Include the grip or balance you prefer and any maker care instructions.

TEAMWEAR & TRAINING

The plan you have in mind

Bring a player list or a simple room measurement. Include your priorities, target date and preferred budget.

GOOD QUESTIONS. USEFUL ANSWERS.

ASK BEFORE
YOU SET OFF.

Do I need to book a service?

Contact the store to confirm availability and whether an appointment or equipment drop-off is needed.

Can I explore each service first?

Yes. Each service card opens a dedicated page with preparation notes, useful questions and relevant next steps.

Can you confirm a price online?

These pages explain the service options. Ask the store to confirm scope, pricing and timing for your equipment.

Does the team form place an order?

No. It downloads a planning brief to your device so you can review it and discuss the requirements with the store.
